name: Frogzz Bar 'N' Grill

evidence.note: Listing for Jim Moran's free Sunday open jam at Frogzz, 3 PM, with house drums, amps and PA.
Public video of a rock and blues jam at Frogzz (Aug 30, 2026); the description lists the musicians only.
Listing summary: local dive bar under new owners, jukebox and frequent local bands; no mention of dancing.

dancing.notes: Frogzz has live bands and a Sunday jam session, but we found no reviews or photos that talk about dancing. Treat it as a place to listen unless you hear otherwise.

description: A neighborhood bar and grill on Main Street in Yaphank with pool, darts and an outdoor deck. It has local bands, karaoke and a Sunday afternoon open jam.
reviewNotes: Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). No official website found, and two different Facebook pages are listed online, so we left Facebook out. Do not confuse with Frogzz Saloon in Lake Ronkonkoma, a different bar.
